# 39th Lucille Lortel Awards

| venue = Skirball Center for Performing Arts
}}
The 39th Lucille Lortel Awards were held on May 5, 2024, recognizing excellence in Off-Broadway productions during the 2023-24 season. Nominations were announced on April 4, 2024, with Wet Brain receiving the most nominations with eight. The Lortel Awards are jointly produced by the Off-Broadway League and the Lucille Lortel Theatre, with support from Theatre Development Fund.
Winners and nominees
The 2023-2024 Lucille Lortel Awards nominations were announced on April 4, 2024 by Amber Iman and George Abud. Wet Brain was the most nominated production, receiving eight nominations, while (pray) won the most awards, with four.
The ceremony was held at the Skirball Center for Performing Arts on May 5, 2024.
